Bidfast

As the first technical hire at a pre-construction startup, I helped build software to make takeoffs and bidding faster for contractors.

My work connected a vector-based PDF detection engine with contractor workflows, product demos, and feedback from early clients.

Start with the structure already in the drawing.

I built a detection engine that works with PDF vector primitives: cleaning and canonicalizing geometry, then combining GHT and chamfer matching with constellation and structural planar arrangement checks.

Vector primitivesCleanup + canonicalizationGeometric matchingStructural verification

Alongside the engineering, I worked with contractors to understand their workflows, ran demos, and iterated with early clients. That experience shaped a practical lesson: a technically ambitious product still needs a focused problem and a clear path to market.
